messages:
maria: Follow-up from the Rate Limiter postmortem: we need concrete customer-facing deliverables and owners. Items: status page blurb, 72h public summary, RCA access policy (redaction + consent), and a short recurring-incident note. Please volunteer owners + dates.

ben: I will take the status page blurb. I'll write a single-sentence TL;DR + one bullet about impact and one bullet about next steps. Draft by 2026-03-27 EOD and will post here for quick sign-off.

liz: I can do the 72h public summary with jordan. I'll focus on clear customer language, an impact matrix, and the mitigation timeline. ETA: 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC. Legal: no customer names or internal IDs in public doc.

sam: I'll own the RCA access policy. Plan: propose three tiers (public summary, impacted-customer detailed RCA, full internal RCA), define redaction rules, and draft a consent/opt-in flow for customers requesting detailed RCAs. Target: 2026-03-25 COB.

jordan: I'll run the recurring-pattern short analysis and include an executive line for the 72h summary about the mitigation plan across incidents. Noting two similar routing-policy regressions in the past 90 days; recommend a targeted routing audit. I'll link to the remediation tracker. ETA: tomorrow morning.

maria: Please add all deliverables to the postmortem action tracker and include explicit POCs. Initial proposed tracker entries added by me: status page (ben) due 2026-03-27 EOD; 72h summary (liz/jordan) due 2026-03-25 23:59 UTC; RCA policy & consent flow (sam) due 2026-03-25 COB; remediation update (eng-sre) due 2026-04-02.

ben: Draft status blurb: "We briefly experienced elevated request throttling due to a misrouted quota policy. Impact: small subset of requests for a short window. Mitigation: traffic reroute and fix deployed. We're implementing a permanent routing guard and improved monitoring." Will remove internal timing per legal and add link to live status page. POC: incidents@redwood.com.

liz: Edit suggestions: use "brief throttling" instead of exact seconds; include impact matrix and short bullets under "what we're doing". I'll fold jordan's recurring-pattern note into the 72h summary.

sam: For consent flow: suggest a short form + checkbox and email to incidents@redwood.com. Default: public summary redacted; detailed timeline available to impacted customers upon explicit request and consent. Legal wants no customer-identifying screenshots. I'll draft the form text.

sre-bot: Postmortem archived: https://intra/redwood/postmortems/rl-2026-03-22-1. Action tracker updated with items above.

maria: Great. I'll set calendar reminders and nudge owners 24h before due dates. If anyone needs to reassign, post here. Thanks all.
